text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali to deliver a speech on Thursday at the occasion of the 9th anniversary of the "change" (when Ben Ali succeeded to Habib Bourguiba).
- President congratulates US President Bill Clinton for his re-election.
- Habib Bourguiba congratulates President Ben Ali at the occasion of the 9th anniversary of the "change".
- President Ben Ali recommends to speed up wage negotiations in the public firms.
